_about: TEST BRAND. "Demo brand" is invented. It exists only to prove that the studio can switch brands: different colours, a different typeface, no accent typeface, no product. Never use it for a real video. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for people and are ignored by the engine.
name: Demo brand

colours._about: A deep green accent on an off-white page, and a dark green night page.

light._on_accent: Left out on purpose, to prove the engine picks the ink that reads better on the accent.

colours._confetti: Left out on purpose: the engine then makes confetti from the roles above.

fonts._about: Inter for everything, from the npm package already installed in engine/. There is no accent typeface, to prove that voice is optional: a *starred* headline word is set in Inter at a heavier weight.

logo._about: A simple wordmark drawn for this test. The letters are lines, so the files need no font.

shape._about: Squarer controls than Tulvo, to show that shapes switch with the brand too.
